title: rustbgpd Overview
description: Session health, RIB scale, churn/distribution, policy, BMP, and RPKI/ASPA overview for rustbgpd. Every panel references metrics exported by the daemon's Prometheus endpoint ([telemetry].prometheus_addr).

panels.title: Peers registered for distribution
panels.description: bgp_rib_outbound_registered_peers: peers currently registered with the RIB manager for outbound distribution — the closest exported gauge to 'currently Established peers'. An Established session missing here has a wedged advertisement path.

panels.title: Loc-RIB routes (all families)
panels.description: Sum of bgp_rib_loc_prefixes across every AFI/SAFI.

panels.title: Update groups
panels.description: bgp_update_groups: update groups with at least one member peer (ADR-0098).

panels.title: Ungrouped (fallback) peers
panels.description: bgp_update_group_fallback_peers: peers on the per-peer distribution path because a v1 disqualifier (peer-context policy, Add-Path send, ORR vantage, negotiated ORF) applies.

panels.title: Session flaps (1h)
panels.description: increase(bgp_session_flaps_total[1h]) summed over selected peers.

panels.title: Event outbox health
panels.description: bgp_event_outbox_degraded: 1 after any outbox drop or open failure since process start (does not auto-clear).

panels.title: Session establishments / flaps
panels.description: Counters bgp_session_established_total and bgp_session_flaps_total as rates.

panels.title: FSM state transitions
panels.description: bgp_session_state_transitions_total by destination state.

panels.title: NOTIFICATIONs by code/subcode
panels.description: bgp_notifications_sent_total / bgp_notifications_received_total.

panels.title: Hold-timer re-arms / stale timer events
panels.description: bgp_hold_timer_rearmed_pending_input_total: hold-timer expiries converted to re-arms because the local daemon was the bottleneck (ADR-0078). bgp_fsm_stale_timer_events_total: timer events in a state where that timer should not run (daemon-side timer bug indicator).

panels.title: BFD sessions
panels.description: bfd_session_up gauge (1 = Up) and bfd_session_flaps_total rate. Empty unless BFD is enabled (ADR-0067).

panels.title: Send hold expirations (RFC 9687)
panels.description: bgp_send_hold_expirations_total: sessions torn down because the peer stopped draining its TCP socket and outbound data could not be written within SendHoldTime (terminated locally without a NOTIFICATION).

panels.title: Graceful restart (RFC 4724 / LLGR)
panels.description: Gauges bgp_gr_active_peers / bgp_gr_stale_routes (peers in a graceful-restart window and stale routes retained for them) plus bgp_gr_timer_expired_total as a rate. Empty unless a GR/LLGR window is active.

panels.title: Loc-RIB prefixes by family
panels.description: bgp_rib_loc_prefixes per AFI/SAFI.

panels.title: Adj-RIB-In prefixes by family
panels.description: bgp_rib_prefixes summed over selected peers per AFI/SAFI.

panels.title: Adj-RIB-In prefixes per peer
panels.description: bgp_rib_prefixes summed over families per peer.

panels.title: Adj-RIB-Out prefixes per peer
panels.description: bgp_rib_adj_out_prefixes summed over families per peer.

panels.title: Attribute intern table size (global)
panels.description: Unique attribute sets in the daemon-wide cross-peer intern table (LAN-336). Flat under steady-state churn; a monotonic slope means reclaim is broken.

panels.title: UPDATE rate in / out
panels.description: bgp_messages_received_total / bgp_messages_sent_total filtered to type="update".

panels.title: Message rate by type
panels.description: All BGP message types (open, update, keepalive, notification, route_refresh).

panels.title: Update-group membership (ADR-0098)
panels.description: bgp_update_group_members per group id; bgp_update_group_regroups_total as a rate (membership churn — should be quiet in steady state).

panels.title: Adj-RIB-Out VPN prefixes per peer
panels.description: bgp_rib_adj_out_prefixes{afi_safi="vpn"}: VPNv4/VPNv6 advertised-route counts per peer. For update-grouped members (ADR-0099) this is synthesized from the group table under the member's RFC 4684 RT filter.

panels.title: RIB ingest pressure
panels.description: bgp_rib_ingest_channel_depth (queued RibUpdates; pegged at capacity = producers parked), bgp_inbound_rib_backpressure_total and bgp_outbound_route_drops_total rates.

panels.title: Route-refresh windows / dirty resync
panels.description: bgp_route_refresh_in_progress and bgp_route_refresh_stale_entries (RFC 7313 enhanced refresh), plus bgp_rib_dirty_resync_total by outcome.

panels.title: Update-group index internals
panels.description: ADR-0098 update-group index gauges: distinct group keys, interned attribute chains, and residue entries awaiting prune (bgp_update_group_keys / bgp_update_group_interned_chains / bgp_update_group_residue_entries).

panels.title: Policy decisions by direction/action
panels.description: bgp_policy_routes_total: routes evaluated through a policy chain, attributed to the terminal-decision policy.

panels.title: Top policies by evaluated routes
panels.description: topk(10) over bgp_policy_routes_total by terminal policy name ("inline" = anonymous chain).

panels.title: Protection rejections
panels.description: Max-prefix teardowns, AS_PATH / RR loop rejections, RFC 9234 OTC blocks and role mismatches.

panels.title: Policy engine errors
panels.description: bgp_policy_eval_errors_total by direction/kind and bgp_policy_dataset_refresh_errors_total by dataset, as rates. Any non-zero rate means routes are taking the configured error-fallback action.

panels.title: BMP drops
panels.description: bmp_source_drops_total (session→manager), bmp_collector_drops_total (manager→collector, by phase), bmp_control_event_drops_total. Any non-zero rate means the BMP feed is lossy.

panels.title: BMP collector replays
panels.description: bmp_replay_attempts_total: PeerUp-cache replays triggered by collector reconnects.

panels.title: Event outbox (ADR-0072)
panels.description: Producer queue depth per category (climbs before drops start), drop rate, and on-disk size of events.db + WAL.

panels.title: RPKI VRPs by address family
panels.description: bgp_rpki_vrp_count: validated ROA payloads currently loaded from the RTR cache.

panels.title: ASPA records
panels.description: bgp_aspa_records: ASPA customer records in the merged table.

panels.title: Validation-cache import refreshes
panels.description: bgp_validation_import_refreshes_total: inbound Route Refresh work triggered by RPKI/ASPA cache updates, by dependency and outcome.

panels.title: Config transactions
panels.description: bgp_config_transaction_lifecycle_total by operation/outcome as a rate: prepare/commit/confirm/rollback activity from gRPC and gNMI config sessions.

panels.title: Event stream subscribers / lag
panels.description: bgp_event_stream_subscribers gauge and bgp_event_stream_lagged_total rate by service/source. Lag events mean a slow subscriber missed broadcast events.

panels.title: Memory (jemalloc)
panels.description: jemalloc allocator gauges (release/container builds only; absent without the jemalloc feature): allocated = live application bytes, active = pages in use, resident = physical memory held.

panels.title: Outbound queue by peer endpoint
panels.description: Absolute coalesced UPDATE frames buffered for each transport endpoint. A sustained backlog is stronger evidence than a short convergence burst.

panels.title: Slow peer endpoints
panels.description: 1 while an Established transport endpoint has persistently failed to drain its outbound queue; 0 after recovery or teardown.

panels.title: Update group by neighbor address
panels.description: Current stable update-group ID for each bare configured neighbor address. -1 is a legitimate value: that neighbor uses the per-peer fallback path.

panels.title: Policy transition in progress
panels.description: Current ownership state only: 1 while the RIB actor owns an export-policy transition, otherwise 0.

panels.title: Last completed policy transition
panels.description: Terminal duration of the most recently completed transition. This retained sample is not the live elapsed time of an in-progress transition.

panels.title: Policy-transition actor poll p99
panels.description: Fifteen-minute p99 by instance, scrape job, and bounded poll kind. This is actor occupancy per poll, not total transition duration.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (instance, job, poll_kind, le) (rate(bgp_rib_policy_transition_actor_poll_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance"}[15m])))

panels.title: Policy-transition actor polls over 200ms
panels.description: Fifteen-minute increase estimate for actor polls above the exact 200ms bucket boundary, preserving instance, scrape job, and poll kind.

panels.title: Accepted policy generation age
panels.description: Informational age of the last successfully accepted full policy generation. It is not an alert threshold; rejected reloads intentionally leave the timestamp unchanged.

panels.title: Max-prefix usage and finite limit
panels.description: Authoritative live session-actor usage and finite configured limit by bounded scope. Limit series are absent for unlimited scopes; every series is absent while disconnected.

panels.title: Max-prefix remaining headroom
panels.description: Saturating finite-limit headroom by live session endpoint and scope. No data means unlimited or disconnected, not zero headroom.

panels.title: Export rejections / malformed UPDATEs
panels.description: Exact-export rejections use the bare configured neighbor address; malformed UPDATEs use the transport endpoint. Both are exceptional route-safety events, partitioned by their bounded reason labels.

panels.title: Selection-deferral state
panels.description: Raw per-family gate state and frozen-roster waiter count. These are normal convergence state, not alert conditions; step rendering preserves discrete transitions.

panels.title: Selection-deferral exceptional events
panels.description: Per-family rates for timer fallback and bounded-ledger overflow. Ordinary all-EoR, collision-refresh, and all-excluded releases are intentionally omitted.
